description: List the documents of the "heldfast-churn-placeholder" knowledge base (/tmp/churn-q95j9dto/heldfast-churn-placeholder): indexed files with their chunk counts and, for a Markdown page, the title and description of its front matter, and files missing from the index or changed since indexing. Filter with paths (folders, files, or globs such as docs/** or **/*.pdf) and page with offset. Use it to answer which documents exist or to choose includePaths for ragmir_search; ragmir_search finds what they say. Read-only.

changedSince.description: An ISO date or time, such as your last pass: adds the indexed files modified since then and those the last ingest removed.

maxBytes.description: Output budget in bytes for this call; the server caps it at its configured maximum.

offset.description: Files to skip; pass page.nextOffset from the previous call to read the next page.

outline.description: With paths naming one file: its outline, each heading path with the citation of its first passage, to expand one section of a long document.

paths.description: Folders, files, or globs such as docs/** or **/*.pdf. Lists every indexed file when omitted.
